This is a script to install and library R packages;

## Install Packages 
```{r}
## ===============================
##  Data Manipulation Packages
## ===============================
renv::install("dplyr")
renv::install("tidyr")
renv::install("tibble")
renv::install("stringr")
renv::install("purrr")
renv::install("data.table")
renv::install("tidyverse")  # Bundles many above packages

## ===============================
##  Visualization Packages
## ===============================
#renv::install("ggplot2")
renv::install("ggplot2@4.0.1")
renv::install("plotly")
renv::install("ggpubr")
renv::install("ggridges")
renv::install("ggrepel")
renv::install("ggvenn")
renv::install("gridExtra")
renv::install("ggfortify")
# renv::install("GGally")     # Optional: for ggpairs
# renv::install("patchwork")  # Optional: for ggplot layout
renv::install("glue")
renv::install("gghalves")
renv::install("tidytext")

## ===============================
##  Statistical Methods
## ===============================
renv::install("poolr")
renv::install("multcompView")
# renv::install("metap")  # Optional: for Fisher's method

## ===============================
##  Bioinformatics Packages
## ===============================
renv::install("seqinr")
renv::install("bio3d")
renv::install("protr")      # For AAindex
renv::install("Peptides")   # Peptide descriptors

## ===============================
##  Circular / Complex Heatmap Packages
## ===============================
renv::install("reshape2")
renv::install("circlize")
renv::install("BiocManager")               # Needed for ComplexHeatmap
BiocManager::install("ComplexHeatmap")     # From Bioconductor

## ===============================
##  Venn & Euler Diagram Packages
## ===============================
renv::install("VennDiagram")
renv::install("eulerr")

## ===============================
## JSON / I/O
## ===============================
renv::install("jsonlite")



```


## Library Packages 
```{r}
## ===============================
##  Data Manipulation
## ===============================
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)       # (includes dplyr, tidyr, ggplot2, etc.)
library(rlang)
library(scales)

## ===============================
##  Visualization Packages
## ===============================
library(ggplot2)        # Core plotting
# packageVersion("ggplot2") # Version 4.0.1
library(plotly)
library(ggpubr)         # Publication-ready ggplot extensions
library(ggridges)       # Ridge plots
library(ggvenn)         # Venn diagrams
library(ggfortify)      # ggplot-friendly stats viz (e.g. PCA)
library(gridExtra)      # Arrange multiple ggplots
library(grid)           # Low-level graphic layout
library(ggrepel)        # Smart label repelling
library(GGally)       # Pairwise plot matrix
# library(patchwork)   # ggplot layout system
library(gghalves)
library(glue)
library(tidytext)  # for reorder_within

## ===============================
##  Statistical Methods
## ===============================
# library(metap)         # Fisher’s combined p-value
library(poolr)           # More robust p-value combination
library(multcompView)

## ===============================
##  Bioinformatics + Sequence Analysis
## ===============================
library(seqinr)          # Sequence input/output & analysis
library(protr)           # Protein descriptors (e.g. AAindex)
library(Peptides)        # Peptide property analysis
library(bio3d)           # Protein structure bioinformatics

## ===============================
##  Circular / Complex Heatmaps
## ===============================
library(reshape2)        # Data melting
library(circlize)        # Circular plots
library(ComplexHeatmap)  # Advanced heatmap layouts

## ===============================
##  Venn Diagrams + Euler Plots
## ===============================
library(VennDiagram)
library(eulerr)

## ===============================
##  JSON / Data I/O
## ===============================
library(jsonlite)        # JSON data handling


```
